statement.zh: Nath《Excavations at Rakhigarhi》(1997–2000 季 ASI 草稿) 记录聚落层位、建筑与有限墓地样本；须标明草稿状态。
statement.en: Nath’s Excavations at Rakhigarhi (ASI draft for 1997–2000 seasons) records settlement strata, architecture, and a limited cemetery sample; draft status must be noted.
